notes: Updating no longer opens a duplicate browser tab. Before, installing an update relaunched the server as a fresh process that always opened a new tab, while your existing dashboard tab also reloaded itself in place — leaving you with two tabs. Now the relaunched server is told to skip the browser-open (PCAV_NO_OPEN_TAB), so the update reloads cleanly in the tab you already have. server.js only.
